memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: These were the offerings of the Israelite leaders for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver plates, twelve silver sprinkling bowls and twelve gold dishes... The total weight of the gold dishes came to a hundred and twenty shekels... The total number of animals for the burnt offering came to twelve young bulls, twelve rams and twelve male lambs a year old... The total number of animals for the sacrifice of the fellowship offering came to twenty-four oxen, sixty rams, sixty male goats and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed. - Num 7:84-88 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
At the end of the twelve days, everything is added up. Twelve silver plates, twelve gold dishes, dozens of animals — the totals are carefully recorded. What had been given day by day, gift by gift, is now gathered into one grand sum offered to God.

There is something worth noticing here. God kept track of every single gift, and now He shows the full total. Each individual offering mattered on its own, but together they added up to something great. The whole was made up of many faithful parts.

This is how God's kingdom works. Each person's contribution may seem small on its own — one gift, one prayer, one act of service. But God gathers them all together, and the total is far greater than we imagine. Nothing given to God is ever lost or wasted; it all counts toward something bigger than we can see.

Sometimes we grow discouraged, thinking our little offering makes no difference. But every faithful gift is counted and added to the whole. The widow who gave two small coins gave more, in Jesus' eyes, than all the rich (Luke 21:1-4). God sees the heart, and He treasures every gift.

Keep bringing your offering, however small it feels. You are part of something far bigger than yourself, and God is adding it all up. Your faithfulness counts in the grand total of His work.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you ever feel your offering is too small to matter?
- How does it encourage you that God counts every gift?
- How is your contribution part of something bigger?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You count every gift and gather them into something great. Help me to keep giving faithfully, trusting that nothing offered to You is wasted. Amen.
